verdict.rationale: Resend is an API-first email service, so it runs headlessly by design. Its REST API, OpenAPI spec, SMTP, official CLI and scoped API keys support non-interactive automation, and idempotency keys make retries safe in automated pipelines. The CLI covers domain verification, segments and webhooks, and the Vercel integration injects API keys as environment variables. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance (e.g. GitHub Actions examples, non-interactive CLI auth via env vars) and independent hands-on reports of running Resend in CI.
